name: The Red Devil
source:
You're a journalist on your way to interview Raven Eros, a mysterious nobleman who people claim is a vampire. You're here to check if all rumors are truth or not.

[From [url=https://drakularts.itch.io/the-red-devil]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名记者，正在前往采访Raven Eros，一位神秘的贵族，人们声称他是吸血鬼。你来这里是为了验证所有谣言是否属实。

[来自[url=https://drakularts.itch.io/the-red-devil]Itch.io[/url]]
